item.title: Ruminations on Past Relationships. Recorded by Allison Carol in situ.
item.content:encoded:
So, Dr. Sinclair has had the basic backstory of 'joined the Serpent's Hand in College, Boyfriend was a massive tool who tried to burn down the school, came to the Foundation after the fact' for a while now. I had intended to write something about an event similar to this earlier in the year (where it turned out her boyfriend 'Burnout' was actually still alive and had tried to take revenge on her) and there are elements of that in here— the escapology course playing a role is a big one, as is Reynolds being injured somehow. Beyond that, it's largely a very different tale.

Thanks to all who looked at this.
